prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original full-frame portrait illustration plate for the share card of a mobile music compatibility app
Primary request: a spectacular, richly illustrated miniature music universe, using the bold geometric vector animation language associated with Kurzgesagt: crisp rounded shapes, intricate layered landscapes, saturated but beautifully organized color, dimensional flat shading, tiny narrative details and a sense of wonder
Composition/framing: tall portrait 9:16 cover, edge to edge, no phone or UI. Upper 38% is a spacious deep midnight-plum star field with very sparse tiny stars, kept quiet for large dynamic score and names that will be typeset later. The focal illustration spans the middle from 38% to 68%: two vividly different little musical planets almost meeting, an orange-coral world on the left and a rose-teal world on the right, connected by sweeping luminous cyan and cream sound-wave ribbons. The lower 32% returns to quiet deep midnight-plum with very sparse tiny stars, so dynamic verdict and two trophy labels can be typeset later.
Subjects: each planet is a spectacular little world made from a vinyl record, rounded hills, tiny playful geometric trees, miniature speaker towers, tactile music motifs, a tiny record-player observatory, colorful stylized clouds and musical notes following the orbital path. Make two worlds visually distinct yet clearly belonging to the same universe. Detailed enough to reward a closer look but instantly readable on a phone.
Palette: deep midnight plum #211b36 and #302343 for the sky, burnt-orange and coral #ed642f #ff9566 for the first world, rose #edc9d7 and vivid turquoise #63d9d1 for the second, touches of warm cream #f7f0e7. Restrained yellow highlights.
Style: sophisticated 2D vector-style editorial illustration; high visual craft, clean precise silhouettes, layered atmospheric scale, no photorealistic or glossy 3D objects
Constraints: original objects and composition, no existing channel mascots, no brand logos or copied artwork, no text, letters, numbers, score, UI controls, screenshots, frames, watermark or poster captions. Preserve the quiet top and bottom regions as compositional space, do not add empty rectangular panels. Flat designed color shapes rather than blurry gradients. This image is artistic, not scientific information.
Output: a stunning illustration that makes a personal music result feel collectible and worth sharing
